title: Transfer between active accounts
description: Transfer funds only when sender and recipient accounts are active.

title: Sufficient balance
description: Reject a transfer exceeding the available sender balance.

title: Daily transfer limit
description: Reject transfers exceeding the configured daily limit of 5000 units.

title: Atomic balance update
description: A successful transfer must debit and credit exactly once.

title: Audit trail
description: Every transfer attempt must have a traceable transaction status.

title: Invalid amount
description: Reject zero or negative transfer amounts.
